data.title: 神裂火织 · 卧房榻榻米上的圣人动情献身
data.description: 昏黄静谧的和风卧室内，深蓝真丝睡袍从高挑雪白的香肩滑落。平时威严无双的圣人跪伏在被单间，乌黑长马尾散落，双颊绯红、眼泛泪光地抱住你的颈项，在急促娇喘中奉献出全部身心。
data.location: dim peaceful Japanese bedroom with soft white futon
data.action: 平时威严无双的圣人跪伏在被单间，乌黑长马尾散落，双颊绯红、眼泛泪光地抱住你的颈项
data.lighting: dim warm ambient lantern light glowing on statuesque curves and flushed skin
data.promptProse: In a dimly lit Japanese bedroom warmed by paper-lantern glow, Kaori sets aside her stern composure on the futon, wrapping both arms around her partner's neck with breathless, tearful devotion.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling close across the lantern-lit tatami futon with both arms looped tightly around her partner's neck, she presses near with flushed cheeks and shining happy tears as her midnight-indigo silk lace nightgown slips off her bare shoulders.
data.nsfwProse: Her flowing midnight-indigo silk slip nightgown trimmed in sheer white lace slides down off her bare shoulders, framing her collarbones and cleavage.
